title: Coleman Hawkins and Bigard, and the need to read music in Chicago
summary: A story of Bigard backing out of a contest with Coleman Hawkins after hearing him practice, and a remark that New Orleans musicians had to read in Chicago.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
